headline: Man City found guilty of widespread financial fraud across 9 years
summary: The Premier League leaders face severe sanctions, including potential relegation and stripping of titles, after being found guilty on almost all 115 charges.
details: Manchester City have been found guilty of widespread financial fraud between 2009 and 2018. The club was found guilty on almost all of the 115 charges they faced, according to a Premier League statement.
The club has announced its intent to appeal the verdict. However, if the decision is not reversed, City faces severe sanctions that could include a hefty points penalty leading to relegation.
There is also speculation that the club could be stripped of some of the trophies and titles they won over the past 15 years, including four league titles won between 2009 and 2018.
The same independent commission that found the club guilty will now determine the sanctions. These could range from a massive fine to expulsion from the Premier League.
Chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak expressed confidence in proving the club's innocence. Meanwhile, rivals like Rio Ferdinand have reacted to the news of the club's potential demise.
The uncertainty continues as the club recently spent around £460 million on new players, while star striker Erling Haaland remains tied to the club via a long-term contract.
caption:
Manchester City found guilty of financial fraud! Relegation or stripped titles? The Premier League giants are in crisis.

Manchester City have been found guilty of widespread financial fraud between 2009 and 2018. The club was found guilty on almost all of the 115 charges they faced, according to a Premier League statement.

The club has announced its intent to appeal the verdict. However, if the decision is not reversed, City faces severe sanctions that could include a hefty points penalty leading to relegation.

There is also speculation that the club could be stripped of some of the trophies and titles they won over the past 15 years, including four league titles won between 2009 and 2018.

The same independent commission that found the club guilty will now determine the sanctions. These could range from a massive fine to expulsion from the Premier League.

Chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak expressed confidence in proving the club's innocence. Meanwhile, rivals like Rio Ferdinand have reacted to the news of the club's potential demise.

The uncertainty continues as the club recently spent around £460 million on new players, while star striker Erling Haaland remains tied to the club via a long-term contract.

headline: Muztaba Khamenei rescued from rubble after second US attack in Tehran
summary: The new Supreme Leader of Iran was reportedly pulled from the debris of a hospital following a series of US and Israeli airstrikes.
details: A religious leader in Iran claims that Muztaba Khamenei was rescued from the rubble of a hospital in Tehran after being targeted by US and Israeli airstrikes.
caption:
Rescued from the rubble of a hospital, Muztaba Khamenei survives two attacks to become Iran's new Supreme Leader.

A religious leader in Iran claims that Muztaba Khamenei was rescued from the rubble of a hospital in Tehran after being targeted by US and Israeli airstrikes.
